long_description.title: The Power to Shape Your Sound Is Now in Your Hands
long_description.body: The Power Players Multi-Effects unit is easy to use for beginners and makes a great fly rig for pros! It features built-in Overdrive, Distortion, and Delay effect modules. The Delay has a Tap Tempo footswitch, so you can quickly set the delay time to synchronize with the tempo of the music you’re playing. A built-in Electronic Tuner with an LED display makes getting and staying in tune easy. The FX Loop, 1/4” Stereo Outputs (with defeatable Cabinet Simulation), and Stereo XLR balanced DI Outputs provide all the connections you need to hook up to amplifiers, external effect pedals, PA systems, and recording systems. There’s even a 1/8” Aux Input so you can connect an external audio player to jam along with your favorite songs. A 9V DC power supply and a 10’ guitar cable are also included.
